development_selection_disclosure: Both issues were reserve candidates in evaluator/candidates.json before any pilot results. Their source/rubric development followed the q001 development pilot. No solver answer or zg outcome on q002/q003 was observed during selection or authoring. This is a purposive two-task expansion, not a random sample or a contamination-free held-out set.
selection_policy: Include both source-verifiable reserve cases with merged fixes, precise pre-fix commits, neutral observable scenarios, independent source review and explicit scoring gates. Keep both cases and every outcome; do not select a subset based on zg performance.

tasks.source_policy: Full git archive of commit, no .git, no submodule initialization or generated artifacts; identical exported source in both arms. Record actual indexed file coverage.

predeclared_metrics.inference_scope: Report two preselected new tasks individually; selected q001 development and same-case confirmation are separate. No population-wide significance or contamination-free claim.
